the 'Chilled Super-Healthy Drink'!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
“—Whyyyy!? Even though I drank it... the 
throbbing's getting WORSEーー!?”

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi

ingredient, and blending it up to make 
Tsuyoshi's special—"

a lingering headache.
